regulatoryFramework: Financial Advisory and Intermediary Services Act, 2002 (FAIS); Financial Sector Conduct Authority (FSCA) regulations; Protection of Personal Information Act, 2013 (POPIA)

responsibleParties.legalPrincipal: UBUNTUctrl Ad‑Hoc Committee (Founder & Director, 2x Community Reps, 2x Regulatory Reps)
responsibleParties.accountabilityMechanism: Multi‑signature governance action recorded immutably; minimum 3 of 5 signatures required.
Governance action ADD_UNDERWRITER / REMOVE_UNDERWRITER with multi‑sig approval; underwriter public key bound to pool.
Governance action EMERGENCY_PAUSE / EMERGENCY_RESUME; recorded immutably; trigger pre‑defined in policy.

responsibleParties.legalPrincipal: UBUNTUctrl Ad‑Hoc Committee (via pre‑approved policy parameters and underwriting events)
responsibleParties.accountabilityMechanism: Code executes deterministically; committee retains over‑ride via emergency pause and policy modification; every execution is cryptographically traceable.

responsibleParties.legalPrincipal: UBUNTUctrl Ad‑Hoc Committee (via arbiter key authorization)
responsibleParties.accountabilityMechanism: SafeKrypte arbiter signature required; arbiter key held by committee; escrow agreement defines release conditions.
Ceremony initiated by governance action; dual‑signature transition proof required; all steps logged.

responsibleParties.legalPrincipal: Data Protection Officer (appointee of UBUNTUctrl Committee)
responsibleParties.accountabilityMechanism: KAYA compliance attestation; field register; consent mechanisms; dual‑write telemetry verification.

partyDesignationStatement: In accordance with FAIS and FSCA requirements, every automated system action is mapped to a named legal principal. The UBUNTUctrl Ad‑Hoc Committee serves as the accountable entity until the UBUNTUctrl Trust is formally registered.
